cases.purpose: Verify standard and legacy independent vectors, wrong password refusal, new hash round trip, retained aging and shadow mode.
cases.script:
export BASHPASSWD_KERNEL_SECRETS=0 PHCLIB_PASSWD=db/passwd PHCLIB_SHADOW=db/shadow PHCLIB_M=1024 PHCLIB_T=1 PHCLIB_P=1
/usr/bin/chmod 640 db/shadow
passwd verify-fd alice 3 3<pw >/dev/null 2>&1; printf 'standard=%s\n' "$?"
passwd verify-fd alice 3 3<wrong >/dev/null 2>&1; (( $? != 0 )) && echo wrong=rejected
printf '%s\n' 'alice:$argon2id$v=19$m=65536,t=2,p=1$736f6d6573616c74$09316115d5cf24ed5a15a31a3ba326e5cf32edc24702987c02b6566f61913cf7:19000:1:90:14:30:20000:' >db/shadow
passwd verify-fd alice 3 3<pw >/dev/null 2>&1; printf 'legacy=%s\n' "$?"
passwd set-fd alice 3 3<pw >/dev/null 2>&1; printf 'set=%s\n' "$?"
passwd verify-fd alice 3 3<pw >/dev/null 2>&1; printf 'new=%s\n' "$?"
/usr/bin/awk -F: '{print "aging=" $4 ":" $5 ":" $6 ":" $7 ":" $8 ":" $9}' db/shadow
printf 'mode=%s\n' "$(/usr/bin/stat -c %a db/shadow)"
cases.stdout:
standard=0
wrong=rejected
legacy=0
set=0
new=0
aging=1:90:14:30:20000:
mode=640
cases.oracle: Pinned independent Argon2 PHC vectors in standard and legacy encodings must verify the known password and reject a wrong password. A newly written hash must verify; independent awk/stat readback must show unchanged aging fields and mode 0640. The new-hash round trip alone is not an independent cryptographic oracle.
